race.description: 2026 Somerset Farms Darrell Alexander Trotting Championship Round 2 - Heat 1
race.comment: GOLDEN SUNSET (7) deserves top billing after going under by only a head as a well-supported favourite last week, having won the G3 the start before. She has already put big margins on key rivals recently and owns outstanding Albion Park 2138m credentials, so the 30m mark is the main obstacle rather than the form. PINNIE (5) is the rebound runner. She broke in the home straight last start, but her prior win over Get Used To It was well backed and she has repeatedly shown she handles this track and trip. HIDE AND SEEK (6) nearly won last week, beaten a neck by Keayang Stuka, and his latest result reads well against Majestic Lavros despite the earlier loss to PINNIE. MAJESTIC LAVROS NZ (2) is the place-leaning selection, honest enough when fourth last start and forgivable to a degree after racing wide outside the leader in the G3 two back, but he has to turn around recent margins on the main chances.
